answer: By tying validator participation to a quadratic slashing function, the protocol forces the marginal cost of a Sybil exploit to scale super-linearly, ensuring that any malicious coalition is disincentivized. At this cryptoeconomic zenith, a zero-knowledge verifiable delay thread guarantees sequential epoch transitions, preventing adversaries from pre-computing block rewards. Consequently, even a minor knoll in adversarial stake causes expected utility to turn negative, cementing a robust Nash equilibrium where honest staking remains the only dominant strategy.
